title: Eclipse's design system
line: «Efemérides»: an observatory. Amber is the light source and the instrument is the visual language: precise, technical, editorial, warm.

serif.role: One huge headline per section, with a single italic amber word

sans.sample: Before we talk, we show you your business working.

mono.role: Indices, units, timestamps and numbers that read like an instrument

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.note: 48 px pills; one amber button per screen, with a diamond-ring glint on hover.

mark.name: Section mark
mark.note: A mono index, a hairline that draws in and the section's eclipse phase.

phase.name: Phase glyph
phase.note: The brand icon: from the full sun to totality, for steps, progress and states.

index.name: Families index
index.note: Number, phase, serif name and a dotted leader; the open row lights up with an amber hairline.

ledger.name: Parts ledger
ledger.note: A list set like a menu: name, dotted leader and the value in mono.

card.name: Card with «Demo»
card.note: Every fictional business carries its «Demo» badge, always in view.

samples.webR: People message you on WhatsApp in one tap, from their phone.
samples.opsR: Customers book and order on their own; you see everything on one screen.
samples.aiR: Every call and every message gets an answer, after hours too.
samples.ledgerLabel: Exploded view of the Equipment kit
samples.cardText: Customers book and order on their own; you see everything on one screen.
